Our story

From The Distribution Side To Your Basement

Before Active Air, Andrew spent 18 years on the distribution side, helping contractors pick the right equipment for their jobs. Now he does the same for homeowners.

Andrew personally visits manufacturers to learn about new heating and cooling technology, so the advice you get is current.

We are a family business rooted in Fairfield County. Your call, message and project go directly to the owner.

Every system we install and every home we work in represents our name and our reputation. That’s why we do things the right way, not the easy way.
